ideas.title: Climb anything
ideas.critique: The island has never been a place the player moves through with their own body and skill. Edges found from real geometry and a hanging body with mass would be a new kind of play. The risk is that the edge finder or the constraint jitters, and the snapping twig is a garnish that will probably turn out scripted.

ideas.title: Footprints that tell on you
ideas.critique: Ground that keeps marks made by pressure, plus a detective goal built on reading those marks, is new for the island and has a real game in it. Getting rain, wetting, drying and puddles that reflect the sky all in one session is a lot, and the plain version is decals with a scripted thief route.

ideas.title: Sandcastle against the tide
ideas.critique: The island already has sand that piles and slumps, so 'sand gives way' is not a new payoff. What would be new is wet sand holding together, dry sand pouring, and sculpting by hand. Live MPM sand at beach scale is unproven, and a slumping film alone would read as a repeat.

ideas.title: Dominoes and contraptions
ideas.critique: The island has already posted a filmed domino chain with a tracking camera, and this would be the same payoff a second time. The real step is that the player places the pieces and mixed bodies with IPC contact; the film should show that building, or it is a repeat.

ideas.title: A marimba you cut yourself
ideas.critique: Pitch that comes from modal beam physics, where you tune an instrument by cutting it, is honest and new, and the physics is small enough to get right. Too short ruining a bar gives the player a real skill to learn. The weak points are friends dancing to the notes, which is an old behaviour, and a quiet workbench film that may not carry visually.

ideas.title: The bees and the smoker
ideas.critique: A swarm that reacts to a smoke field drifting in the wind is a new kind of motion and a new kind of play: herding with a cloud you have to lead. Thousands of boids that read as bees in a traced film is the hard part, and the hive pulling them home once smoke is thick enough is a scripted shortcut.

ideas.title: Skate the thin ice yourself (project glass-sea)
ideas.critique: This is a real step: the player's own weight on a plate model that bends and cracks, where a crack they start stays. That moves the project from looking at frozen water to playing on it. The film will still look like 'friends on dark glossy sea' unless the sagging and the crack chasing the skater clearly read, and the friends pulling them out risks being scripted.

ideas.title: Bank shot
ideas.nearest: Skipping stones, a take that misses
same_form: Skipping stones, a take that misses
ideas.critique: Another single thrown object, which the last posts have done three times. The difference is that the player aims it and gets a pool-like skill, and that part is solid. Bouncing off real meshes with ray queries is good engineering, but a pebble bouncing three times looks like the earlier physics studies.

ideas.title: Grass fire
ideas.critique: A fire front spread by fuel, moisture, wind and slope, with burnt ground that grows back over days, is a simulation the island has never had, and it answers the goal's 'burn'. Fighting it with firebreaks has real tactics. Emissive flames plus a smoke fluid in one session will probably shrink to a coloured cellular automaton under fake glow.

ideas.title: The island wakes the echo friends (project island-echo)
same_form: The island answers a clap, a broken take
ideas.critique: The echo picture has already been posted twice, with one of those posts broken, so a third clap film is the same payoff. What is new is a playable goal: finding friends that move, with a cost for each clap. Only if that loop works live is it a step and not a retake.
